NOT AVAILABLE TO STUDENTS

Situated in the heart of the West End, just a few minutes' walk from Haymarket Train Station and Edinburgh's Financial District, The McEwan offers a mix of studios, 1-bed, 2-bed and 3-bed homes plus exceptional duplex apartments with your own garden space.

476 interior designed apartments with state-of-the-art amenities including a residents' gym & studio, media room and games room, two private dining spaces, a designated co-working space & shared lounges. Residents also have access to a range of spectacular roof top terraces with views of the city including the iconic Edinburgh Castle.

Get ahead of the crowd...reserve your apartment today!

YOUR APARTMENT

Furnished 3-bed apartment with open-plan living, kitchen and dining space.

Double bedrooms with ottoman storage & feature headboard.

Bathroom with deluxe rainfall shower.

1x en-suite shower room of similar design.

Cosy living area with 2 X 2-seater sofa & dining space for six.

Fitted kitchen with integrated Samsung appliances.

Floor-to-ceiling windows with private patio.

YOUR KITCHEN

Open-plan, sleek & modern with quartz worktops and integrated Samsung appliances including touch control ceramic induction hob, oven, fridge freezer and washer dryer. Room to dine with marble-effect dining table and six chairs.

YOUR LIVING AREA

Light and spacious with floor-to-ceiling windows. Luxurious two-seater sofa, lounge chair, media storage unit with 50" Samsung 4K Smart TV & coffee table with mirrored top.

YOUR BEDROOM

Stylish bedroom including fitted wardrobes with full-height internal mirror, double bed with ottoman storage, feature headboard & 1,000 individual pocket sprung mattress made from natural materials.

YOUR BATHROOM

Bathroom with contemporary porcelain tiling throughout. Bath with overhead deluxe sized rainfall shower, WC and heated towel rail, plus bespoke vanity cabinet with LED lighting.

Council Tax Band: F

Promotional offer. Save 20% on your rent for the first 12 months.
